<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the monoisotopic ion appears at m/z 224.1201, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral exact mass of ≈ 223.1128 Da. Considering the observed ~17 % M+1 intensity (consistent with ~13 C plus the contribution of a sulfur isotope) and fitting the exact mass, the formula C₁₃H₁₉OS matches the data within a few ppm. Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is:</thought>
<final_answer>C13H19OS</final_answer>
